stories.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon for analytical and coding workflows
stories.alt: Conceptual panel showing Gemini 4 Neon access through API, enterprise workflows and the Gemini app; access is subject to rollout and plan eligibility.
stories.facts: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon and announced rollout through its API, enterprise offerings, Antigravity and eligible paid Gemini app plans. Google positions it for complex coding, analytical and scientific workflows.
stories.inference: Why it matters: evaluate a frozen MATLAB debugging and data-audit task set before switching research assistants; measure correctness, latency and reproducibility separately.
stories.uncertainty: Availability depends on rollout and plan. Vendor benchmark claims do not establish trading profitability or MATLAB-specific reliability.

stories.title: Equity Transformer study finds training history depends on forecast horizon
stories.alt: Study-design panel showing training quantities of six, twelve and twenty-four months tested against five-to-120-minute forecast horizons; no universal winner is implied.
stories.facts: The preprint compares twelve configurations under a fixed Transformer and feature set, using monthly walk-forward evaluation and 264 refits. More training data did not uniformly improve accuracy; the preferred historical sampling varied with forecast horizon.
stories.inference: Why it matters: test history selection jointly with forecast horizon in the MATLAB research protocol, with a frozen model architecture and cost model.
stories.uncertainty: Intraday information-coefficient evidence is not net trading P&L. Results do not prove a causal recency benefit or transfer to daily SPY forecasts.

stories.title: Nasdaq futures lead a reported rebound ahead of Anthropic trading
stories.alt: Bar chart showing reported Dow futures up 0.67%, S&P 500 futures up 1.25% and Nasdaq 100 futures up 2.15% at 5:48 a.m. EST on November 19.
stories.facts: Reuters reported Dow E-minis up 0.67%, S&P 500 E-minis up 1.25% and Nasdaq 100 E-minis up 2.15% at 5:48 a.m. EST (4:48 a.m. CST), ahead of Anthropic’s expected Nasdaq debut.
stories.inference: Why it matters: verify QQQ versus SPY concentration and opening liquidity before extrapolating a technology-led gap into an executable continuation signal.
stories.uncertainty: Reported snapshot, not live executable quotes. A positive futures gap does not establish order-book depth or the IPO’s eventual opening price.

stories.title: Fed minutes show broad support for further tightening under baseline forecasts
stories.alt: Conditional-policy diagram showing baseline inflation and labor forecasts leading to likely further tightening, while incoming data determine subsequent decisions.
stories.facts: The October minutes say almost all participants judged further rate increases would likely be appropriate under their baseline outlooks. A couple said a move larger than 25 basis points could warrant consideration at the next meeting if inflation data were unfavorable.
stories.inference: Why it matters: stress equity-duration exposure and rate-sensitive hedges across alternative policy outcomes rather than hard-coding a single expected move.
stories.uncertainty: These are conditional views from October, released November 18, not a new rate decision or a commitment about December.

stories.title: Palo Alto Networks reports growth alongside a wide GAAP adjustment gap
stories.credit: Palo Alto Networks FY27 Q1 release, Nov. 18
stories.alt: Earnings panel showing Palo Alto Networks revenue growth of 39%, GAAP operating income of 96 million dollars and non-GAAP operating income of 1.1 billion dollars.
stories.facts: Palo Alto Networks reported fiscal first-quarter revenue of $3.44 billion, up 39%. GAAP operating income was $96 million versus $1.1 billion on a non-GAAP basis. Its fiscal 2027 revenue outlook is $14.52–$14.57 billion.
stories.inference: Why it matters: distinguish demand growth from the adjustments supporting profitability measures before adding an earnings-quality or growth signal.
stories.uncertainty: Company-reported results and forward-looking guidance; GAAP and non-GAAP measures are not interchangeable. No share-price reaction is inferred here.
